Name: Dishevelled Shane - Shane Portrait Mod (CP)
Author: corrallie
Description:
Hi all, this is a portrait mod for Shane, changing his portraits to a more dishevelled version of him whilst maintaining the vanilla art style. I have a lot of love for Shane but never really felt like his portrait did his in-game personality justice, so this mod hopefully gives him a bit more life in that sense. To do this I have revamped his clothes, given him scruffy hair and eye-bags (to keep up with all that drinking of course), and an eyebrow piercing with a stretched ear just to spice up his appearance a tad. I plan to eventually do more of the bachelors and bachelorettes with sprites included! As this is my second ever mod, I would appreciate any feedback or bug reports.

If you like this mod, go and check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49685]Pierced Sebastian[/url] mod too!

You're welcome to edit, recolour, or build on these portraits for your own mods, with credit to 'corrallie'. Please don't use these images to train, fine-tune, or generate content via AI/generative tools.

[b]Installation Instructions:[/b]
 - Download the .zip file.
 - Extract the .zip file.
 - Move the new folder into the 'mods' folder next to your 'Stardew Valley.api'
 - Load Stardew Valley and that shoould all be good to go!

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] are required for this mod.
